[ASSISTANT_CREATED] b) When facilitating a team-building exercise  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] c) When delivering a technical training that requires specific knowledge and skills  
[USER] User asked for the correct answer to the question about when a trainer should avoid using the Socratic Method in a workshop.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant apologized for the misunderstanding and provided the correct answer: c) When delivering a technical training that requires specific knowledge and skills.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that in a technical training requiring specific knowledge and skills, it may be more appropriate for the trainer to present information clearly rather than engage in discussion or use the Socratic Method.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that the Socratic Method is more useful in situations requiring critical thinking and analysis, such as brainstorming or team-building exercises.
